description: Scans GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/*.yml), CircleCI (.circleci/config.yml), and GitLab CI (.gitlab-ci.yml) workflow files for dangerous secret interpolation patterns. Detects ${{ secrets.* }} and ${{ github.token }} used directly in run: steps (log_leak risk — GitHub Actions logs the expanded plaintext) and ${{ github.event.pull_request.* }} / issue / commit content interpolated in shell commands (injection risk — attacker-controlled input). Returns file, job, step, pattern_found, risk, and recommendation.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the repository root to scan

name: scan_ci_workflows
